fields.Name: IT169 - Record Change Snapshots Record the Stored Row
fields.Description: Server-transport saves write their Record Change FullRecordJSON from the row the save returned. RCS1 a create's snapshot holds the stored ID, both timestamps and the joined Parent display name; RCS2 a stale writer's update snapshot carries the change another writer committed after it loaded the record, and the stored __mj_UpdatedAt, while ChangesJSON lists only its own change; RCS3 an apostrophe is recorded as written; RCS4 an encrypted column (MJ: Credentials.Values) is recorded as its stored ciphertext on create and update, never the plaintext. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every snapshot matches the stored row: server-set values, other writers' changes, text as written, and ciphertext for encrypted columns.
